segments.text: Provides information about one or more of your managed nodes, including the operating system platform, SSM Agent version, association status, and IP address. This operation does not return information for nodes that are either Stopped or Terminated.

If you specify one or more node IDs, the operation returns information for those managed nodes. If you don’t specify node IDs, it returns information for all your managed nodes. If you specify a node ID that isn’t valid or a node that you don’t own, you receive an error.
